capabilities.description: Full PR review: diff analysis, verdict (APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES/COMMENT) with numbered findings and severity. Side-delivery: Slack DM to the configured reviewers.

requestSchema.force: boolean? (re-review even if same state reviewed)

capabilities.prompt: Review pull request {{pr}} in {{repo}}. Fetch with: gh pr view/diff. Correctness first, then reuse/simplification/perfor

capabilities.description: Tech detective: trace a bug, behavior, or regression across a repo's code and git history. Returns a causal answer with file/line/commit evidence.
capabilities.prompt: Investigate in {{repo}}: {{question}}. Walk code + git history/blame, related PRs. Answer with the causal chain, citing

capabilities.description: CI/CD failure triage: read a failed pipeline run, classify root cause (code / flaky / infra / dependency), name the culprit or declare flaky with evidence.

requestSchema.logBlob: string? (raw logs if no runId access)

capabilities.prompt: Diagnose failed CI run {{runId}} in {{repo}} (branch {{branch}}). Fetch logs with gh run view --log-failed. Classify: co

capabilities.description: Generate release notes from a merged-PR range, grouped (Features/Fixes/Chores/Breaking) with PR links and risk flags.
capabilities.prompt: Generate release notes for {{repo}} from {{fromRef}} to {{toRef}}. Group Features/Fixes/Chores/Breaking with PR links; f

capabilities.description: Alert intake: classify severity, dedupe against open work, attach deploy/PR context, return a ranked notice with recommended first action.
capabilities.prompt: Triage this alert: {{payload}}. Classify severity, dedupe against recent work, attach deploy/PR context, recommend first

capabilities.description: Summarize any document, thread, or long PR discussion into decisions + action items with owners + open questions.
capabilities.prompt: Summarize: {{content}}{{url}}. Output decisions, action items with owners, open questions.

executionModel: transport in framework; logic in agent
